messages:
jen: quick ping — proposal to add a golden-copy 'route_uid' column to console_telemetry to speed quota/dashboard joins. low-risk dual-write + backfill pattern?

mike: +1 on performance win. what's the exact shape? single string route uid?

jen: yes string(64), indexed. idea is to denormalize the route id we currently join via route_meta table to avoid expensive joins for per-route p99/usage dashboards. also helps quota evaluations in the hot path.

sam: concern: storage blowup and retention cost. analytics store is huge. have we estimated token growth?

lina: we looked at a 12% size increase on a sample shard, with ~30% reduction in query CPU because joins vanish for common dashboard queries. tradeoff seems favorable for realtime stuff.

carol: UX/rollout question — how do we surface this in console? do we need to version the dashboard queries or can we keep them compatible?

jen: plan: 1) modify ingest service to dual-write route_uid into envelope v2 as optional field behind feature flag 2) write backfill job to populate route_uid for last 90 days 3) dashboard queries prefer route_uid if present, fallback to join 4) canary on a small tenant cohort 5) monitor accuracy/regressions

mike: fallback logic in SQL looks like:

```sql
SELECT coalesce(route_uid, (SELECT uid FROM route_meta WHERE id = telemetry.route_id)) as route_uid_resolved
FROM console_telemetry telemetry
```

mike: that's fine but we should push fallback to query planner-friendly expression so we don't force nested subqueries every time. maybe a left join with route_meta and use coalesce(route_uid, route_meta.uid)

sam: backfill strategy? streaming job or batch? how to keep consistency window small?

jen: backfill will be a streaming worker scanning time ranges and writing to a shadow column; workers mark progress via a migration_state table. we'll run it at low priority across shards. backfill will also emit an audit row count for verification.

lina: please add a safety gate: if shadow write rate causes more than 5% ingest lag on GPUS we throttle. ops-bot should enforce.

carol: ops question: do we need a new index? maybe a partial index on route_uid WHERE route_uid IS NOT NULL to avoid index bloat.

mike: agree. partial btree on (route_uid) WHERE route_uid IS NOT NULL. will dramatically reduce index size.

jen: patch DDL:

```sql
ALTER TABLE console_telemetry ADD COLUMN route_uid text NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS console_telemetry_route_uid_notnull_idx ON console_telemetry(route_uid) WHERE route_uid IS NOT NULL;
```

jen: rollout phases: dev -> staging (dual-write + backfill small window) -> canary tenants (10 tenants) -> 50% traffic -> full. each phase gated by a telemetry baseline check.

sam: what telemetry baselines? latency, p99 for query endpoints, storage delta, backfill error rate, and dashboard metric parity.

lina: add a quality check: sample 5000 events, compute route resolution via join vs route_uid and assert >99.99% match. if mismatch, auto-pause rollout.

mike: API contract note: if any user consumes raw console_telemetry rows, adding a nullable column is safe, but we must document in changelog and SDKs. tiny heads-up to partners.

carol: who owns the migration runbook and the rollback playbook?

jen: devex will own runbook, eng-platform owns the backfill code, eng-sre owns the canary gating & rollback ops. I'll draft runbook and share.

deploy-bot: migration-job-1739131000 scheduled: console_telemetry.add_route_uid (flags: dual_write=true, partial_index=true)

mike: telemetry plan: metrics: backfill_progress, mismatch_rate, ingest_lag, index_build_time, storage_delta. set alerts on mismatch_rate > 0.01% or ingest_lag > 3s sustained.

sam: add a dashboard card for parity comparison so PMs can eyeball regressions.

lina: small nit — ensure JSON serialized payload size in hosted pipeline doesn't exceed Kinesis/stream limit after adding field. looks fine on sample but add a guard.

jen: good call. we'll add sampling in staging. I'll post the runbook link once drafted.

carol: sounds solid. thumbs up from me if safety gates and partial index are in place. :thumbsup:

jen: thanks all — will open PRs for DDL + dual-write change, and a follow-up for the backfill worker. tagging @lina @sam for gating checks when ready.

deploy-bot: migration-job-1739132000 started: backfill (shard 3/16)

jen: keeping thread open for post-canary notes.
